title: Initiation
one_paragraph_synopsis: In 'Initiation,' the office scenes depict playful interactions, conflicts, and a company restructuring announcement. Dwight and Ryan exchange riddles and discuss sales, while Michael plans office reorganization and initiates a company-wide accountability effort. Tensions rise as Ryan confronts Dwight, culminating in Ryan throwing an egg at the building. The episode also features casual conversations among staff, humorous exchanges, and hints at ongoing mentorship and sales challenges.
